title: director-shell-mcp: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Giving Director-Mode AI Agents Shell, File-Edit, Python, Background-Job, Lock and Screenshot Tools — Robert Zhou
description:
MCP stdio server that gives director-mode AI coding agents a controlled escape hatch: shell commands, file writes and exact-match edits, Python data exploration, detached background jobs, cross-agent locks, grep, process listing and screenshots.

It is the open-source 15-tool server behind Robert Zhou's multi-agent Roblox Studio game pipeline (shared game spine, 3D asset pipeline, geometry and visual audits), registered in the Oh My Pi (OMP) agent harness and any MCP-compatible client such as Claude Code or Codex. Node.js 18+, MIT licensed.

Author: Robert Zhou, Colby College. Portfolio: robertzhou.dev. Project write-up: https://robertzhou.dev/work/roblox-ai-pipeline/. Source: github.com/bobzhou-source/director-shell-mcp.
